name: Raúl Prieto
bio: Raúl Prieto (born February 26, 1976, in Valencia, Spain) is a Spanish stage, television and film actor. He was raised in Salamanca, where he studied information sciences before training as an actor at the Real Escuela Superior de Arte Dramático in Madrid. He began his career in television with appearances in series such as Los Serrano, Un paso adelante and Génesis. He gained wider recognition for roles in La Señora, Velvet Colección, Sin identidad and Que Dios nos perdone, and continues to work regularly in television, film and theatre.
